Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?
Yes, damaged items are handled differently than regular returns.
Damaged/incorrect items: We ask you to contact our Customer Service team right away and provide photos of the issue via live chat or email so a claim can be reviewed and resolved. Claim approval is needed to ensure proper handling and potential shipping-fee adjustments.
Normal returns: You simply start a return through our Returns Portal, choose your reason, get a prepaid label, wrap and ship the rug back. For standard returns, return shipping fees are always deducted from your refund, and each item has its own fee and label.
So, a damaged item goes through a claim process with photos sent to us, while a normal return is processed directly through the online portal with automatic return shipping fees deducted.
